paper_title: Mapping the Minds of LLMs A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM
caption_used: Convergence ratio (gamma_C) as a function of the number of few-shot examples, comparing Correct and Incorrect reasoning outcomes. The chart shows grouped bars for each shot count (0 through 4), with Incorrect outcomes in blue (dotted pattern) and Correct outcomes in red (diagonal stripes). For Correct outcomes, gamma_C remains relatively stable at approximately 0.6 across 0 through 2 shots before declining to roughly 0.53 at 3 shots and approximately 0.28 at 4 shots. For Incorrect outcomes, gamma_C decreases from about 0.25 at 0 shots to around 0.05 at 2 shots. The convergence gap between Correct and Incorrect narrows progressively, with the most significant narrowing occurring between 2 and 3 shots, where Incorrect gamma_C rises slightly to approximately 0.10 while Correct gamma_C begins its decline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the convergence ratio (γ_C) as a function of the number of few-shot examples, with grouped bars for each shot count ranging from 0 to 4 along the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Shots”. The vertical axis is labeled “γ_C” and spans from 0.0 to 0.6, marked with evenly spaced grid lines and numerical labels at intervals of 0.2, indicating a linear scale. Each shot count has two adjacent bars: one for “Incorrect” reasoning outcomes, represented by a blue bar with a dotted pattern, and one for “Correct” reasoning outcomes, represented by a red bar with diagonal stripes, as indicated in the legend. The bars are arranged in ascending order of shot count along the horizontal axis. The height of each bar corresponds to the value of γ_C for that category. For the “Correct” outcomes, the bar heights are approximately 0.6 at 0 shots, remain at approximately 0.6 at 1 shot, decrease to approximately 0.56 at 2 shots, further decrease to approximately 0.53 at 3 shots, and continue to decrease to approximately 0.28 at 4 shots. For the “Incorrect” outcomes, the bar heights start at approximately 0.25 at 0 shots, decrease to approximately 0.20 at 1 shot, decrease further to approximately 0.05 at 2 shots, remain at approximately 0.05 at 3 shots, and remain at approximately 0.05 at 4 shots. There is no visual indication of any specific emphasis or highlighting on any particular bar or group of bars.
model_annotations.English: This grouped bar chart illustrates the convergence ratio, denoted as γ_C, as a function of the number of few-shot examples, ranging from 0 to 4 shots, comparing outcomes categorized as “Correct” and “Incorrect.” The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Shots,” presents the shot count in integer increments from 0 to 4, ordered sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “γ_C,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. Each shot count has two adjacent bars: the left bar, colored blue with a dotted pattern, represents “Incorrect” outcomes, while the right bar, colored red with diagonal stripes, represents “Correct” outcomes, as indicated by the legend in the upper left corner. For the “Correct” outcomes, the bar heights are approximately 0.60 at 0 shots, 0.60 at 1 shot, 0.56 at 2 shots, 0.53 at 3 shots, and 0.28 at 4 shots. For the “Incorrect” outcomes, the bar heights are approximately 0.25 at 0 shots, 0.20 at 1 shot, 0.05 at 2 shots, 0.05 at 3 shots, and 0.05 at 4 shots. The bars are not sorted but are presented in ascending order of shot count along the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern differentiation.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Konvergenzrate γ_C als Funktion der Anzahl an Few-Shot-Beispielen, wobei die Ergebnisse in „Correct“ und „Incorrect“ unterteilt sind. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Anzahl der Shots, die von 0 bis 4 reicht und linear skaliert ist, während die vertikale Achse γ_C mit einer linearen Skala von 0.0 bis 0.6 beschriftet ist und in 0.2-intervalligen Schritten markiert ist. Für jede Shot-Anzahl (0 bis 4) sind zwei gruppierte Balken dargestellt: der linke Balken für „Incorrect“ ist blau mit einem punktierten Muster und der rechte Balken für „Correct“ ist rot mit diagonalen Streifen. Bei 0 Shots beträgt der Wert für „Incorrect“ etwa 0.25 und für „Correct“ etwa 0.60. Bei 1 Shot sinkt der „Incorrect“-Wert leicht auf etwa 0.20, während der „Correct“-Wert bei etwa 0.60 bleibt. Bei 2 Shots fällt der „Incorrect“-Wert auf etwa 0.05, während der „Correct“-Wert bei etwa 0.57 liegt. Bei 3 Shots steigt der „Incorrect“-Wert leicht auf etwa 0.07, während der „Correct“-Wert auf etwa 0.53 abfällt. Bei 4 Shots beträgt der „Incorrect“-Wert etwa 0.05 und der „Correct“-Wert etwa 0.28. Die Balken sind nach der Shot-Anzahl von links nach rechts in aufsteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet, wobei die Balken für „Incorrect“ und „Correct“ jeweils in der gleichen Gruppe nebeneinander stehen. Es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung oder besondere Formatierung einzelner Balken, außer der Farbe und des Musters, die durch die Legende definiert sind.
